derivation: patronymically from an unused name (from H6395 (פָּלָה)) meaning separate;
def: a Pelonite or inhabitant of an unknown Palon

occurrences.text: Shammoth the Harorite, Helez the Pelonite,
Hepher the Mecherathite, Ahijah the Pelonite,
The seventh captain for the seventh month was Helez the Pelonite, of the children of Ephraim: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
